Meet Kordia

For over 60 years, we've built resilient networks that endure

From broadcast and critical infrastructure to cyber security and cloud, Kordia keeps New Zealand connected. We’re engineers, technologists, media specialists, and cybersecurity experts who solve problems and get things done. Our clients trust us to deliver. With a legacy of tackling complex challenges, we help businesses face the future with confidence.

Cyber security
Protect your business against cyber threats with our 24/7 x 365 days a year Security Operations Centre (SOC), digital forensics and incident response, and guidance from Aura Information Security.
Critical communications & infrastructure
Our engineers, field technicians and riggers support your critical communication and infrastructure needs - from design and build to maintenance.
Broadcast solutions & content distribution
Helping broadcasters navigate the shift to digital and cloud-based content delivery models with efficiency, scalability, and quality of service.
Cloud
Secure, best-performing cloud services you can trust, with in-house advice and support from our specialist cloud consultancy.
Wholesale
With one of the country’s largest networks – and coverage just about everywhere – Kordia’s solutions and services are more than competitive.
Maritime communications
Trusted to manage and operate the network that provides vital communication services for almost 1/4 of the worlds oceans.

HOW WE HELP YOU

Experts in designing, building & maintaining critical networks

Unmatched expertise
For over six decades we’ve engineered networks that underpin New Zealand’s broadcast, maritime and critical-communications landscape. Our engineers design the very systems that monitor nearly a quarter of the world’s oceans, while our structural engineers build towers and infrastructure to exacting standards. Today, we’ve expanded into consulting across cyber-security, cloud and connectivity, bringing deep specialist knowledge to everything we solve. With Kordia, you access a team of trusted experts who know how to tackle complexity and deliver systems that work.
Robust reliability
Our networks are built to endure. Many of our major transmission and communications sites are rated to “Level 4 importance”, designed to remain operational during severe weather, earthquakes and outages. From our nationwide field engineers and technicians to innovative backup systems (digital microwave radio, diverse links and more), we deliver resilient connectivity across New Zealand. We don’t just build networks - we maintain, monitor and continuously improve them so your business stays connected when it matters most.
24/7 x 365 service
Critical business communications don’t sleep. That’s why our Security Operations Centre (SOC), Network Operations Centre (NOC) and Maritime Operations Centres (MOC) operate around the clock, every day of the year. From cyber-threat detection and response to real-time network monitoring and safety-of-life-at-sea communications, we keep eyes on glass so you don’t have to. When seconds count, our teams are ready - ensuring your systems are protected, supported and always on.

We’re proud to be accredited with Gendertick status

The GenderTick is an accreditation programme for organisations to demonstrate their commitment to and actions towards advancing workplace gender equity. The GenderTick enables workplaces to showcase their leadership across six key areas: equal pay, leadership representation, flexible work & leave, gender safe workplace, gender inclusive culture, and supporting the menopausal transition.
